snippet.title: Frostpunk 2: Breach of Trust | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🌋Get #Frostpunk 2: #BreachOfTrust expansion: https://re.11bits.com/grt
❄️Get Deluxe Edition with 50% OFF: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/60233/Frostpunk_2_Deluxe_Edition/
💙PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/EP4361-PPSA16608_00-0890166627321320
💚XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/frostpunk-2-breach-of-trust/9P0DX8F4KH78/0010

The new scenario DLC for Frostpunk 2 is OUT NOW on PC and consoles! In Breach of Trust, you will lead the independent colony of New Edinburgh through a brutal, narrative-driven campaign. Navigate relations with the independent colony of Aurora and face lethal new hazards like Tremors and Volcano Nights.

Will you balance 5 unique factions through peaceful trade or total conquest? The City must survive, no matter the cost.
